title: Anyone been here? It’s the top floor of the casino once you take the elevator all the way
content: It’s definitely at the top of the casino building. I got in the elevator and came out here. Everything was white and the platform was round. Strangely, when I got out of the elevator doors, these doors in the image were in front of me. When I turned round to see where I’d come from, there was nothing but white. I then had that “call of the void” feeling where I wanted to see if I could fall off. So I did a big running slide and did fall over the side, however caught onto the rim and pulled myself back up.
